notes.subject: fix(final-status): reject continuation actions on waiting_for_user
notes.summary: set_task_status now rejects continuation fields with waiting_for_user, failed calls no longer end the turn or show as final-status cards, legacy waiting cards hide next-step actions, and prompts steer the agent to finish safe work before waiting.
